nodes.name: public/giveaways/cross-cli-compatibility-routing-prompt.md
nodes.summary: Orchestrator prompt for cross-CLI routing architecture migration. Guides discovery of current capability system, lane classification (recipe/worker/workflow), preserves deterministic infrastructure, generates capability index, phase-based migration strategy, and validation/testing requirements.

nodes.name: scripts/abandoned-checkout-control.mjs
nodes.summary: CLI control panel for abandoned checkout automation workflows (day1, t12h). Commands: status (read current config), set-mode (off/test/live), set-test-recipients. Stores state in Supabase event_automation_controls table.

nodes.name: scripts/backfill-event-registrations.mjs
nodes.summary: Backfills Supabase event_registrations from Stripe paid checkout sessions by event_slug. Fetches sessions (180-day window), deduplicates by email + session ID, filters test entries, inserts with cancel_tokens. Usage: node scripts/backfill-event-registrations.mjs <event_slug>

nodes.name: scripts/send-dinner-tonight-reminder.mjs
nodes.summary: Sends event-day reminder emails to confirmed attendees (connection-dinner-canggu) with self-serve cancel links that auto-trigger waitlist. Dry-run mode by default. Resend API integration with idempotency keys.

nodes.name: scripts/sync-abandoned-checkout-suppressions.mjs
nodes.summary: Syncs email suppression list from ~/.myos/workspace/agents/events-manager/data/checkout-attempt-suppressions.json into Supabase event_checkout_followup_suppressions. Upserts by email, updates reason and active status.

nodes.name: src/app/100-ai/page.tsx
nodes.summary: Passive Income 100 lead magnet landing page. Launch date countdown (target 2026-06-19). Displays 5 benefits + 10 content sections. Form collects firstName + email, POSTs to /api/lead-magnets/passive-income-100. Controlled countdown timer, error handling, submission state.

nodes.name: src/app/ai-os-architecture/page.tsx
nodes.summary: Iframe wrapper page for AI Operating System Architecture guide. Loads /ai-os-architecture.html at 100% width/height, no border. Metadata title/description for SEO.

nodes.name: src/app/api/lead-magnets/claudemd/route.ts
nodes.summary: Lead magnet delivery API for Joe's Ultimate CLAUDE.md file. Embeds CLAUDE.md content at build time. On POST: validates firstName + email, upserts to Supabase leads, ingests to Mission Control CRM (non-blocking), sends via Resend with file attachment. Resend payload includes HTML email with content preview + attachment.

nodes.name: src/app/api/subscribe/route.ts
nodes.summary: Demo subscribe API endpoint. Accepts firstName + email POST, logs to console. Reference implementation for workshop participants who wire their own Supabase + Resend integrations.

nodes.name: .claude/skills/gitnexus/gitnexus-cli/SKILL.md
nodes.summary: GitNexus CLI command reference: analyze (build/refresh index), status (check freshness), clean (delete index), wiki (generate docs from graph), list (show indexed repos). Covers flags, when to run each, and troubleshooting.

nodes.name: .claude/skills/gitnexus/gitnexus-debugging/SKILL.md
nodes.summary: GitNexus debugging workflow: query for error text/symptoms → identify suspect → get full context (callers/callees) → trace execution flow → use Cypher for custom traces. Patterns for error messages, wrong returns, intermittent failures, performance issues.

nodes.name: .claude/skills/gitnexus/gitnexus-exploring/SKILL.md
nodes.summary: GitNexus exploration workflow for understanding architecture: read context → query for concept → review processes → get symbol context → trace flows → read source. Resources (context, clusters, processes) and tools (query, context) for navigation.

nodes.name: .claude/skills/gitnexus/gitnexus-guide/SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Quick reference for GitNexus tools and resources. Maps tasks to skills (exploring, impact-analysis, debugging, refactoring, cli, guide). Lists tools (query, context, impact, detect_changes, rename, cypher, list_repos) and resources (.../context, .../clusters, .../processes, .../schema).

nodes.name: .claude/skills/gitnexus/gitnexus-impact-analysis/SKILL.md
nodes.summary: GitNexus impact analysis workflow: measure blast radius of changes using gitnexus_impact (upstream direction for dependents), gitnexus_detect_changes (git-based impact), and risk assessment. Depth tiers (d=1/2/3) map to risk levels (WILL BREAK / LIKELY AFFECTED / MAY NEED TESTING).

nodes.name: .claude/skills/gitnexus/gitnexus-refactoring/SKILL.md
nodes.summary: GitNexus refactoring workflows for rename, extract module, split function/service. Checklists for each pattern. Tools: gitnexus_rename (automated multi-file), gitnexus_impact (map dependents), gitnexus_detect_changes (verify scope). Risk rules for string refs, external APIs, many callers.
